initial.hero:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a landscape game character exploration sheet for TUMP, a warm Filipino street-sport game. Create THREE genuinely different options for a seventh hero, working name Rafi, a fictional young adult Sama Dilaut man from Tawi-Tawi with personal water magic. Not final production art. Compose three generous columns on dark muted charcoal, labelled only "A", "B", "C". Each column contains one full-body three-quarter character and one small profile head study showing tiny magical gill slits along his neck. Keep every character entirely visible.
Style: polished stylized low-poly 3D character concept, cute chunky chamfered block proportions, head about 40 percent of height, short substantial arms and legs, confident simple facial expressions, clean fine black ink outlines, big deliberate color shapes, restrained flat materials and soft studio lighting. Hands must be single simple bevelled rectangular mitt blocks with NO THUMBS, NO FINGERS, no fist anatomy. Warm brown skin, dark hair, recognisably human faces. Gills are this individual's supernatural feature, not a claimed ethnic biological characteristic.
A: agile current athlete, cropped dark hair with an uneven front sweep, loose sleeveless indigo sports top, sand-colored cropped shorts, a single restrained woven shoulder strap, open lightweight sandals. Alert tilted posture and a narrow crescent of water sweeping beside him.
B: compact, confident boat-repair athlete with wavy tied-back hair, rolled short-sleeve sea-green shirt, navy work shorts, small practical waist pouch and rope loop, simple flip-flops. Substantial arms, grounded stance, holding a floating folded sheet of water in front of one block hand.
C: playful water-feint specialist, soft shaggy side-parted hair, off-white loose short-sleeve shirt, dark teal wrap-over sports shorts, one small rust woven pouch, simple flip-flops. Low sideways athletic lean and one abstract watery reflection echo, not a second extra human.
Different clothing construction, silhouettes, hair, stance and water shapes, not palette swaps. Contemporary community clothing informed by waterside life; no invented tribal tattoos, no face paint, no sacred scripts, no generic indigenous regalia, no armour, no guns, no weapons, no fish monster anatomy. Never copy the same textile pattern over every item or ability. Minimal textile detail on one accessory only. Do not make Minecraft characters or realistic humans. No logos, no extra prose, no watermarks.
initial.map:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a landscape comparison sheet with THREE clearly distinct map concepts labelled only "A", "B", "C" for TUMP, a cheerful competitive Filipino street game with chunky outlined low-poly art. Planning only, not a gameplay screenshot. Three wide scene panels stacked vertically, each with enough width to show a whole playable space from an elevated player-friendly three-quarter view.
Setting: a fictional contemporary Sama Dilaut stilt-house village inspired by Tawi-Tawi waterside architecture. Warm timber houses are supported on visible fixed wooden piles above clear turquoise seawater, with weathered roof planes, some corrugated sheet repairs, everyday hanging laundry, a few woven mats and modest colourful household details. Small dugout boats and one houseboat at the village edge. This is a lived-in community, not a theme park or luxury resort. All homes and main decks have believable fixed structural support. No levitating houses.
A: the boardwalk neighbourhood. A broad continuous timber playing deck runs between two staggered rows of stilt homes. Open central court, distant sea beyond, crossing walkways and tiny porches outside the court.
B: the community jetty. A generous fan-shaped pier court at the end of a long access deck. Homes cluster asymmetrically to one side; moored boats and blue open sea form the other side. Strong view towards a distant island silhouette, a shaded community shelter outside the playing space.
C: the sheltered lagoon. A broad octagonal central community playing deck surrounded at a respectful distance by an irregular ring of stilt homes, connected with several roomy bridges. Shallow translucent water and boat channels visible between them. Distinct curved overall composition from A and B.
Every panel must keep a broad FLAT safe unobstructed central play area, small simple court marks and one modest tin can target; no maze of narrow jumping platforms, no huge arena stadium, no damage or destruction of homes. Tiny chunky block-proportioned inhabitants outside the play area give human scale. Polished clean low-poly 3D concept render, dark ink edges, warm wood and cream, turquoise sunlit water with indigo shadows, tropical daylight, carefully composed open space, restrained readable material detail. No pasted repetitive textures, no photorealism, no graffiti motifs copied everywhere, no interface, no text beyond A B C, no watermark.
